description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutablePipeline' implementing the 'Pipeline' interface, responsible for executing a sequence of function expressions on pipeline elements, with validation and equality methods.

classes.name: ImmutablePipeline
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Pipeline interface that executes function expressions on pipeline elements.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pipeline by applying each stage expression to the input element using the function expression.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates each stage expression to ensure the function expression supports it; throws exception if not.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on functionExpression and stageExpressions.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on functionExpression and stageExpressions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the ImmutablePipeline object.
